title: Do not access provider credentials during fresh startup
description: Fresh GhostSHELL startup currently enumerates macOS Keychain metadata from MainWindowViewModel construction and restored AI-provider selection eagerly discovers models, which resolves the stored OAuth session. macOS may prompt for the login Keychain password before the user requests AI or Secrets access.
acceptance_criteria: Constructing MainWindowViewModel performs no secret metadata enumeration. Constructing/restoring AgentChatViewModel performs no model discovery or OAuth credential read. Explicit Secrets/MCP navigation and Refresh models retain their current behavior. Focused tests and the full repository gate pass.
notes: Fixed by deferring native secret metadata enumeration to explicit Secrets/MCP navigation and deferring provider model discovery to the explicit Refresh models action. Focused App regression set passed 125/125; ./scripts/check.sh --full passed on 2026-08-20.
close_reason: Closed

title: Bind governed browser navigation to the verified connection peer
description: SEC-005 remains partially open after origin binding and private-address admission. The application resolves and approves a hostname, but Chromium independently resolves/selects the actual peer after CEF Continue(); SSH-routed browsing also lacks equivalent remote-side destination attestation. Implement a connection path that binds the approved hostname to an admitted peer while preserving TLS hostname validation, plus an equivalent remote policy.
acceptance_criteria: A controlled rebinding test with approved and private listeners proves the private listener receives no connection; local and SSH-routed navigation enforce equivalent destination policy; all existing browser policy tests and the full repository gate pass.

title: Restore native image and PDF previews through killable bounded workers
description: SEC-011 and SEC-012 are closed fail-safe by removing ImageMagick and PDFium production registrations. Restore those formats only through packaged per-RID worker processes with hard memory, CPU, output, and wall-clock limits; cancellation must terminate the worker and untrusted documents must never execute in the desktop process.
acceptance_criteria: TIFF/HEIC/PSD/RAW and PDF previews run only in bounded killable workers on every supported RID; timeout and resource-exhaustion fixtures terminate the worker without affecting the desktop process; packaging, legal closure, and the full repository gate pass.

title: Remove agent-specific notification shims

close_reason: Removed all agent-specific notification shims and hooks; terminal ingress remains protocol-based. Added architecture regression guard and verified a fresh macOS bundle.

title: Separate application-security keys from user credential vault
description: The dedicated ApplicationSecurityVault and ordinary credential vault both use the macOS service app.ghostshell. Broad credential metadata enumeration can therefore include app encryption keys/startup pepper; Global+UserManagement operations may expose them to credential-management flows. Moving services without migration would orphan keys and can brick encrypted profiles.
acceptance_criteria: Application-security material uses a distinct native-vault namespace. Existing config/cache/startup-protection keys migrate atomically from the legacy service without data loss or lockout. Ordinary credential listing and management cannot enumerate, relabel, replace, resolve, or delete reserved security references. Cross-platform migration and failure-path tests pass.

title: CEF startup rejects development profile link
description: Launching the macOS development bundle exits during embedded Chromium startup with: Browser profile storage contains an unexpected filesystem link. Diagnose the exact link and preserve fail-closed handling for unsafe profile roots while accepting/removing legitimate CEF artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: The macOS development bundle starts with a legitimate existing CEF profile tree. Unsafe root/ancestor/reparse-point substitution still fails closed. Focused tests and the full repository gate pass.
notes: Root cause had two parts: CEF creates legitimate singleton/version symlinks inside its owned profile tree, and macOS Chromium requests the generic Chromium Safe Storage key even for GhostSHELL's ephemeral contexts. Fixed by deleting child links without following targets while rejecting a linked root, and by enabling Chromium's documented use-mock-keychain switch only when cache/session persistence is disabled. Exact macOS development bundle reached the running GUI; focused Browser tests passed 15/15; ./scripts/check.sh --full passed.
close_reason: Closed
